news.title: STAT+: At ESMO, AstraZeneca’s cancer pursuits get a showcase
news.summary: AstraZeneca has seen major momentum in oncology in recent years. It got a big showcase at Europe's top cancer conference.

news.title: STAT+: After a cancer vaccine’s first success, the race is on to expand the impact
news.summary: After 100 years, there's finally an effective cancer vaccine. Now comes the push to get them to work in more tumor types.

news.title: STAT+: The ESMO presentation everyone’s been waiting for
news.summary: Moderna and Merck's 'presidential' presentation, and other news from Day 2 of the European Society for Medical Oncology meeting in Madrid.

news.title: Opinion: Christina Applegate puts a face on one of the most consequential challenges in neurology
news.summary: “The goal is not simply to diagnose MS faster. It is to get the diagnosis right,” writes Bruce Bebo.

news.title: Opinion: STAT readers on Elizabeth Holmes, cancer screening, and more
news.summary: “Even if Theranos had a functioning testing machine, the economic model on which is was based would result in failure,” writes a STAT reader.

news.title: Chutes & Ladders—Johns Hopkins Health System CEO plans 2027 retirement; RFK Jr. advisor Calley Means resigns
news.summary: Welcome to this week's Chutes & Ladders, our roundup of hirings, firings and retirings throughout the industry. Please submit the good news—or the bad—from your shop, and we will feature it here at the end of each week.

news.title: Mass General Brigham cuts jobs impacting clinical, operational programs amid $300M budget shortfall
news.summary: Less than two years after a wave of administrative layoffs, Mass General Brigham began a new round of job cuts last week that affect clinical and operational programs, according to media reports.

news.title: CMS launches $275M nurse staffing initiative for nursing homes
news.summary: The agency predicts the effort will support more than 4,000 nurses nationwide.

news.title: House Oversight Committee chair probes PBMs on independent pharmacy audits
news.summary: The chair of a key House panel is pressing major pharmacy benefit managers on whether they retaliated against independent pharmacies for publicly supporting reform efforts.

news.title: Centene sues CMS over its 2027 Medicare Advantage star ratings
news.summary: Centene has become the latest insurer to sue the federal government over its 2027 Medicare Advantage star ratings.

news.title: HHS, DOJ unveil pilot program for self-disclosure of False Claims Act violations
news.summary: The Trump administration is rolling out a new pilot program for companies that voluntarily self-disclose False Claims Act violations.

news.title: Weekly Rundown: Quest Diagnostics reports cybersecurity breach; Novant Health launches virtual men’s health clinic
news.summary: The latest news from Novant Health, Function, Withings, Quest Diagnostics and more.

news.title: 89% of voters want Congress to act on hospital prices, poll finds
news.summary: Eight in 10 respondents report reducing healthcare prices should be a high legislative priority, up from 71% in 2024.

news.title: Fierce Healthcare Regulatory Recap: New women’s health initiatives in Trump EO; CMS doles out RHTP funding to 3 more states
news.summary: The latest news from CMS and HHS this week: a new national kidney care plan, more RHTP funding released and more.

news.title: Op-ed: The case for a primary care triple-double
news.summary: To bolster outcomes at cost, double investment in primary care, double the reach of primary care and double the share of clinicians entering primary care, write heads of the American Academy of Family Physicians and the National Association of Community Health Centers.

news.title: Few Americans say CDC, FDA are doing a good job: survey
news.summary: Public confidence in the CDC and FDA has fallen to record lows, with just 26% and 25% of Americans, respectively, rating the agencies’ performance as excellent or good in a Gallup poll.

news.title: Redesign Health, ARC Global merge in $2B deal to accelerate health system innovation
news.summary: The three organizations—Redesign Health, ARC Global and AVIA—work with more than 100 health systems on five continents, and the companies and products built across their networks have reached more than 100 million patients worldwide.

news.title: ESMO: BMS’ Massacesi hails ‘very promising’ data for BioNTech-partnered PD-L1xVEGF-A drug
news.summary: Bristol Myers Squibb Chief Medical Officer Cristian Massacesi, M.D., has told Fierce that the latest data for its BioNTech-partnered PD-L1xVEGF-A drug are “very promising,” as phase 3 ambitions ramp up.v

news.title: ESMO: Roche touts ‘convincing’ phase 3 KRAS data after win over rivals
news.summary: Roche has shed more light on its investigational KRAS G12C inhibitor’s phase 3 victory over Amgen’s Lumakras and Bristol Myers Squibb’s Krazati.

news.title: ESMO: AstraZeneca exec insists phase 3 ADC data ‘robust’ enough for regulators despite PFS miss
news.summary: An AstraZeneca executive was adamant that detailed data from a phase 3 study of the pharma’s next-generation antibody-drug conjugate are “robust” enough to take to regulators, despite the trial failing to meet a key endpoint.

news.title: ESMO: J&J exec says RIPTAC readout is ‘best data we’ve ever seen’ for a prostate cancer drug
news.summary: A year after paying over $3 billion for Halda Therapeutics, Johnson & Johson has unveiled the first data from its shiny new RIPTAC pipeline that it believes could sustain its leading role in prostate cancer.

news.title: ‘It is what it is’: Merck exec unruffled by ‘unfortunate’ leak of ESMO cancer vaccine data
news.summary: Merck & Co. and Moderna always knew they would be making headlines in Madrid this week—just not in the way it happened.

news.title: ESMO: Lilly touts 79% ADC response rate in competitive ovarian cancer space
news.summary: Eli Lilly has shared phase 1 data on an antibody-drug conjugate in platinum-sensitive ovarian cancer, shedding light on the company’s chances of competing for a market targeted by rivals including AbbVie and Genmab.

news.title: ESMO: GSK cancer R&D chief says mo-rez data ‘reinforces our belief’ in ADC as phase 3 push ramps up
news.summary: GSK’s cancer R&D chief has suggested the latest slice of early-stage data on its B7-H4-directed antibody-drug conjugate (ADC) has “reinforce[d] our belief in the asset,” as the therapy races through a clutch of phase 3 studies.

news.title: Roche puts numbers behind phase 3 kidney disease win amid blockbuster ambitions
news.summary: Roche's Genentech has put numbers behind its phase 3 success in IgA nephropathy (IgAN), reporting that antisense oligonucleotide sefaxersen reduced a key marker of kidney damage by 43.1% compared with placebo.

news.title: ESMO: Boehringer builds case for late-phase rival to Amgen’s Imdelltra
news.summary: Boehringer Ingelheim has shared data on its DLL3xCD3 T-cell engager, providing pointers to the prospects of a would-be rival to Amgen’s Imdelltra that entered phase 3 this year.

news.title: ESMO: Zentalis already dreaming of launch for WEE1 inhibitor after ‘great result’ in early-stage test
news.summary: Zentalis Pharmaceuticals has pointed to the first overall survival (OS) analysis for azenosertib as proof that the oral WEE1 tyrosine kinase inhibitor can offer a convenient oral treatment for a tricky cancer.

news.title: EQT buys molecular diagnostics specialist Qiagen in a €10.8B deal
news.summary: EQT is buying up Netherlands-based Qiagen in a deal worth €10.8 billion ($12.1 billion) in enterprise value that includes $1.1 billion in net debt.

news.title: ESMO: Takeda’s $1.2B bet on Innovent ‘absolutely’ pays off with details of ADC’s phase 3 win
news.summary: Takeda has lifted the lid on the phase 3 win for its next-generation claudin18.2 drug, with the antibody-drug conjugate (ADC) demonstrating overall survival of 10.2 months.

papers.title: Agent Mosaic: Recognizing Confidentiality Leaks in Agentic LLM Systems
papers.summary: Modern LLM agents can retrieve information from accessible documents, and then disclose a sensitive conclusion assembled from them. This mosaic effect creates a critical risk for agents operating over confidential data. We quantify its realization with 30 synthetic cybersecurity, medical, and military examples, yielding 10,800 final answers from three LLM agents in controlled simulation and 1,440 answers from live agents in two open-source harnesses.
